visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a dimly lit, high-end commercial gym. A extremely muscular man with a buzz cut wearing a tight olive-green t-shirt and grey joggers stands in the foreground, gesturing toward a long rack of dumbbells. Beside him is a younger man with voluminous curly dark hair, wearing a dark green t-shirt and white shorts with bright orange socks. The background is filled with various weight machines and a few distant gym-goers. (2) The camera follows as they move to the free weights area. The coach continues to speak with a serious facial expression while the student looks on attentively. They stand next to a power rack where heavy iron plates are stacked. (3) The student attempts a heavy deadlift while the coach watches with hands on his hips. The student fails to move the bar significantly, looking strained. The coach leans in, gesturing with his hands in an explanatory manner. (4) The student is now seated on an inclined gym bench holding two large dumbbells. The coach stands over him, pointing and talking. The lighting is warm and directional, emphasizing the muscle definition of the coach. (5) The student stands up, holding a single dumbbell, and walks away towards the back of the gym where a reception-style counter is visible in the distance. The coach stays behind, looking towards the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A deep, resonant male voice begins speaking in Mandarin with a professional tone. The background features a mid-tempo pop track with synthesized melodies and a steady drum beat. Subtle indoor room tone of a gym is present. (2) A sharp metallic clink occurs as a weight is shifted. The first speaker continues, his pitch moderately low and steady. The BGM remains consistent in volume behind the vocals. (3) A louder percussive thud and metallic rattle indicate a barbell hitting the floor or rack. A second, younger male voice responds briefly with a higher pitch and softer volume. (4) The first speaker's tone becomes more instructional yet slightly comedic in its serious delivery. Another metallic clang occurs as a weight is placed back. (5) The conversation continues with high speech density. The BGM maintains a major key and cheerful vibe. A final metallic slide and click sound as the student walks off, followed by a concluding statement from the main speaker.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide humorous entertainment by using gym etiquette rules as satirical metaphors for relationship advice. The video aims to engage fitness enthusiasts with relatable gym scenarios while subverting expectations with deadpan comedic delivery about life and dating.
